components.name: Signal Button
components.css: .ds-signal-button { border: 1px solid rgba(243,230,0,.84); background: linear-gradient(180deg,#f3e600,#dcc600); color:#090909; padding:.625rem 1rem; font-family:Teko,sans-serif; font-size:1.02rem; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.08em; text-transform:uppercase; cursor:pointer; transition:transform 180ms ease,filter 180ms ease,box-shadow 180ms ease; box-shadow:0 12px 24px rgba(243,230,0,.12); } .ds-signal-button:hover { transform:translateY(-1px); filter:brightness(1.04); box-shadow:0 14px 28px rgba(243,230,0,.18); } .ds-signal-button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #fff05f; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Input Shell
components.description: Dark operational input with a tight visible focus state.
components.css: .ds-input-shell { width:100%; border:1px solid rgba(243,230,0,.14); background:rgba(4,4,4,.9); color:#f5f1d6; padding:.625rem 1rem; font-family:Archivo,sans-serif; outline:none; transition:border-color 160ms ease,background-color 160ms ease,box-shadow 160ms ease; } .ds-input-shell:focus { border-color:rgba(243,230,0,.36); background:rgba(12,12,12,.96); box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(243,230,0,.16); } .ds-input-shell::placeholder { color:#78716c; }

components.name: HUD Panel
components.description: Authored high-hierarchy panel with clipped technical corners.
components.css: .ds-hud-panel { position:relative; overflow:hidden; display:grid; gap:8px; border:1px solid rgba(243,230,0,.18); background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(21,21,21,.96),rgba(10,10,10,.96)); color:#f5f1d6; padding:24px; clip-path:polygon(0 0,calc(100% - 22px) 0,100% 22px,100% 100%,18px 100%,0 calc(100% - 18px)); box-shadow:0 24px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.36),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.02); } .ds-hud-kicker { color:rgba(243,230,0,.82); font:600 .68rem JetBrains Mono,monospace; letter-spacing:.28em; } .ds-hud-panel strong { font:600 2.15rem/.92 Teko,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.05em; }

components.name: Window Chrome
components.description: Movable VEIL OS application shell with a tactile title bar.
components.css: .ds-window { overflow:hidden; border:1px solid rgba(227,193,96,.28); border-radius:16px; background:linear-gradient(160deg,rgba(15,11,21,.95),rgba(6,5,10,.97)); color:#f4f6fa; box-shadow:0 30px 90px rgba(0,0,0,.55),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.04); } .ds-window header { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; padding:10px 14px; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08); font:600 .62rem JetBrains Mono,monospace; letter-spacing:.08em; } .ds-window > div { padding:24px; font:500 .5rem JetBrains Mono,monospace; color:rgba(227,193,96,.72); } .ds-window button { width:24px; height:24px; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08); border-radius:6px; background:rgba(255,255,255,.03); color:#f4f6fa; cursor:pointer; } .ds-window button:hover,.ds-window button:focus-visible { background:rgba(255,255,255,.09); outline:1px solid rgba(227,193,96,.6); }

components.name: Launcher Result
components.description: Compact application or system action in the floating launcher.
components.css: .ds-launcher-item { display:grid; grid-template-columns:auto 1fr auto; align-items:center; gap:10px; width:100%; min-height:58px; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07); border-radius:9px; background:rgba(255,255,255,.025); color:#f2f4f8; padding:9px 10px; text-align:left; cursor:pointer; transition:140ms ease; } .ds-launcher-item:hover,.ds-launcher-item:focus-visible { border-color:rgba(227,193,96,.42); background:rgba(227,193,96,.09); outline:none; } .ds-launcher-icon { display:grid; width:31px; height:31px; place-items:center; border:1px solid rgba(227,193,96,.38); border-radius:8px; color:#f0d875; } .ds-launcher-item strong,.ds-launcher-item small,.ds-launcher-item em { display:block; font-family:JetBrains Mono,monospace; font-style:normal; letter-spacing:.08em; } .ds-launcher-item strong { font-size:.58rem; } .ds-launcher-item small,.ds-launcher-item em { color:rgba(202,212,226,.45); font-size:.4rem; }

narrative.northStar: VEIL OS // New Vega Civic System
narrative.overview: RPGSILVER is a dark, authored civic interface for a fictional city. Its shared shell reads as durable public infrastructure: precise, institutional, and slightly industrial. VEIL OS keeps the desktop and wallpaper open and breathable, while VEGA MESH supplies the restrained language of local authority and secure city routing.
keyCharacteristics: Void-black infrastructure with acid-yellow signal color and restrained operational blue/red status accents.
Teko display headings, Archivo body copy, and JetBrains Mono for labels, metadata, and system language.
Depth reserved for active or floating hierarchy; default surfaces stay materially quiet.
Distinct application identities without a flattened component language.

rules.name: The Signal, Not Scenery Rule
rules.body: Acid, blue, red, and app accents must explain hierarchy, state, ownership, or action. Do not spray them across a surface as atmosphere.

rules.name: The Three Voices Rule
rules.body: Use display for hierarchy, body for reading, and mono for system grammar. Do not make every sentence look like a terminal label.

rules.name: The State-Only Depth Rule
rules.body: Do not make every panel float, glow, blur, or look like glass. Elevation must communicate active hierarchy or a temporary system layer.

dos: Do preserve VEIL OS as an open desktop with purposeful floating system layers.
Do use Public Grid Acid, Verification Blue, Signal Red, and app accents to explain state, authority, or interaction.
Do maintain the display/body/mono hierarchy and compact operational label language.
Do let individual VEIL OS applications retain meaningful visual identities.
Do preserve responsive, keyboard-accessible, focus-visible, and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't flatten ECHO, PULSE, IDEN, NVN, or LOOP into the same component language.
Don't cover every surface with cards, blur, glow, gradients, or decorative neon.
Don't turn the desktop into a dense dashboard or sacrifice wallpaper and breathing room for unused widgets.
Don't add generic SaaS bento layouts, oversized hero typography, or decoration without an operational purpose.
Don't use elevated/glass surfaces where no active hierarchy or state transition exists.
